The Grumpy Badger Who Found a Smile: Joy Is Contagious! — Boris the Badger woke up on the wrong side of the burrow and growled! How did one smiling bunny melt his grumpy heart?
Kids science answer for "spreading kindness cartoon for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Frowns push friends away, but giving a genuine smile triggers mirror neurons in others, instantly bouncing happiness right back to you.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
